content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the B53 driver using outdated handling for SERDES (Serializer/Deserializer) configurations through direct MAC-layer callbacks, which led to improper link state management and configurations. The conversion to phylink_pcs facilitates a cleaner and more maintainable approach for managing physical-layer device operations by utilizing the phylink interface for configuring and managing SERDES links, thus correcting the link state handling.
